contributions.title: ci: standardise tooling and CI
contributions.bodyHTML:
## Summary

Brings the tooling in line with the shared setup. This is a Yew site deployed to GitHub Pages, so no release-please and no release binaries. The existing Pages deploy workflow is kept.

- `.mise.toml`: add prek and shellcheck (actionlint), pin tombi to 1.2.5 so `mise run format` and prek agree, and add a `hooks` task. Format tasks use `find` so yew-fmt covers nested `src` files.
- `prek.toml`: converted from `.pre-commit-config.yaml` (deleted). Shared hook set and revs. The local yew-fmt hook is kept, and rustfmt and clippy move to doublify.
- `.github/workflows/test.yml`: new `pre-commit` job (mise-action and prek-action). The test job is unchanged.
- `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`: only the repository name in the build step is quoted (actionlint SC2086). Otherwise unchanged. Already SHA-pinned with least-privilege permissions.
- `.editorconfig`, `tombi.toml`: shared versions.
- `.github/dependabot.yml`: new, cargo and github-actions, weekly, 7-day cooldown.
- `Cargo.toml`: shared clippy lint table (pedantic, `unsafe_code` denied). The existing `unwrap_used` and `expect_used` denies are kept.
- Source: `assert!(x.is_empty())` on collections becomes `assert_eq!(x.len(), 0)`, plus a few small clippy fixes, all mechanical.

## Manual steps

None.

## Verification

- `prek run --all-files` clean on two consecutive runs.
- `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` clean.
- `cargo test --all-features`: 124 passed.
- `mise run build wrk-graphs` (the deploy's production build) succeeds.

contributions.title: fix: only update the requested hostname and make logging work
contributions.bodyHTML:
- Logging calls passed fields as keyword arguments, which stdlib logging
  rejects with TypeError, so every log line crashed the run. Pass them via
  `extra=` and derive the reserved-field set from a bare LogRecord.
- `--log-format json` passed the formatter class instead of an instance.
- The record lookup filtered by type only, so every A/AAAA record in the
  zone was rewritten to the new address. Filter by hostname too.
- Updates forced `proxied: true`; keep the record's proxied and ttl.
- The hostname was overwritten with the zone name, so a missing record
  was created at the apex. A missing record also returned 2 before the
  create path could run. Create it for the requested hostname.
- Zone detection assumed the zone is the hostname minus its first label.
  Try each suffix against Cloudflare, most specific first.
- Failed adds/updates were logged as successful and exited 0.
- Quote-escaping in the key=value formatter was a no-op.

Stacked on #2 (needs its test and lint setup). GitHub retargets this to `master` when #2 merges.

## Tests
New: `tests/test_update_records.py` drives `update_records` against an in-memory fake of the Cloudflare client. `tests/test_logger.py` covers both log formats. 13 tests pass on Python 3.8 and 3.13. prek, ruff and ty are clean.

Not tested against the live Cloudflare API.

contributions.title: ci: standardise tooling with prek, tombi, zizmor and shared lint configs
contributions.bodyHTML:
## What changed

- `.mise.toml` (new): `node` lts, `pnpm`, `prek`, `shellcheck`, `tombi` (pinned `1.2.4` to match the tombi-pre-commit rev in `prek.toml`), `zizmor`. Tasks: `build`, `test` (smoke build), `format`, `format:check`, `lint` (zizmor), `lint:fix`, `check`, `hooks`, `clean`.
- `prek.toml` (new): glypher base hooks plus a local `prettier --check` via `pnpm exec`.
- `.editorconfig`, `.yamlfmt.yaml`, `tombi.toml`, `.prettierrc.toml`: canonical. `.prettierignore` ignores `_site`, `.mise`, `pnpm-lock.yaml` and `node_modules`.
- `.github/workflows/validate.yml` renamed to `ci.yml`: `pre-commit` (prek-action) and `check` (`mise run check`) jobs. Triggers unchanged (`master`), SHA-pinned, `persist-credentials: false`.
- `.github/dependabot.yml`: merged. Added weekly cooldown and a 10 PR limit to both entries; existing groups kept.
- `.github/zizmor.yml` (new): scopes `unpinned-uses` and `artipacked` to `static.yml` only.
- `mise.lock` added (tracked, as in the other repos).
- `.github/workflows/static.yml` (the GitHub Pages deploy) is untouched.

## Decisions

- **Canonical prettier config applied, which reflows 19 files.** The repo previously had no prettier config (prettier defaults: printWidth 80, double quotes). The canonical config changes slide markdown wrapping, the CSS/HTML/JS under `content/_includes/`, and two SVGs. This is in its own `style:` commit (`0a2619b`) so it can be dropped if you do not want the reflow. Please check the slides render as before. The build passes.
- **No release-please, no publish job.** This is a site.
- **No new Pages workflow.** `static.yml` already deploys to GitHub Pages on push to `master`.
- **zizmor is scoped to `static.yml`** rather than editing that deploy workflow. The findings are tag-pinned actions and `persist-credentials` in that file. TODO: pin it in a follow-up.

## Manual steps

- Repo settings: the GitHub Pages source must remain "GitHub Actions" (unchanged). None otherwise.

## Pre-existing failures

- None left after the style commit. `prek run --all-files`, `mise run check` and `pnpm build` pass.

contributions.title: ci: standardise tooling with prek, tombi, zizmor and shared lint configs
contributions.bodyHTML:
## What changed

- `.mise.toml`: added `shellcheck`, `tombi` (pinned `1.2.4` to match the tombi-pre-commit rev in `prek.toml`), `zizmor`. Added `test` (smoke build), `hooks`, `check:actions`, `format:toml`, `format:toml:check`. `check` runs `test` and `check:actions`. Existing tasks kept.
- `prek.toml` (replaces `.pre-commit-config.yml`, which is deleted): glypher base hooks, plus the former YAML hooks (JoC0de prettier, markdownlint-cli2 on `content/`, cspell on `content/`) SHA-pinned at the same versions.
- `.editorconfig`, `.yamlfmt.yaml`, `tombi.toml`: canonical.
- `.prettierrc.toml`: canonical with `printWidth` kept at 120 (see below).
- `.prettierignore`: ignores `.mise` (generated mise lock sidecars that prettier cannot parse).
- `.github/workflows/lint.yml` renamed to `ci.yml`: `pre-commit` (prek-action) and `check` (`mise run check`) jobs, SHA-pinned, `persist-credentials: false`.
- `.github/dependabot.yml` (new): github-actions and gomod, weekly, 7-day cooldown.
- `mise.lock` added (tracked, as in the other repos).
- Separate `style:` commit: tombi formatting of `config.toml` and `wrangler.toml`.

## Decisions

- **printWidth 120, not canonical 100.** At 100, prettier would reflow existing content. 120 also matches `.markdownlint.jsonc` MD013.
- **No release-please, no publish job.** This is a site.
- **No new deploy workflow.** The README says deploy is Cloudflare Pages (`wrangler.toml`, `pages_build_output_dir`), not GitHub Pages. Cloudflare's own deploy is unchanged.
- **Prettier hook kept on the JoC0de repo hook.** It is the repo's existing hook, so it is not duplicated as a local hook.

## Manual steps

- None for the repo itself. Cloudflare Pages keeps deploying from main.

## Pre-existing failures

- None found by `prek run --all-files` or `mise run check` after the `style:` commit.

contributions.title: ci: standardise tooling configs
contributions.bodyHTML:
Standardises tooling with the glypher reference setup. This is a crates.io library, so the publish flow is unchanged.

## Changes

- `build:` add `[lints.rust] unsafe_code = "deny"`. The existing clippy pedantic table stays. tombi also reflowed the `tokio` dependency line in `Cargo.toml` onto multiple lines (formatting only).
- `ci:` `.pre-commit-config.yaml` is converted to `prek.toml`. The hooks and SHA revs are the glypher ones. Repo-specific hooks are kept: `check-toml`, and `yamllint --strict`. The local rustfmt and clippy hooks are replaced with doublify/pre-commit-rust. The pre-commit.ci `update:` block (cooldown and freeze) has no prek equivalent, so it is dropped. Dependabot's 7-day cooldown covers the same need.
- `ci:` `test.yml` is renamed to `ci.yml` and restructured. It has a `pre-commit` job that runs prek, and a `test` job that runs `cargo test --all-features` after it. The fmt and clippy steps moved into prek. The `RUSTFLAGS`/`RUST_BACKTRACE` env is kept.
- `ci:` `dependabot.yml` is updated with a metrics group and the glypher cooldown and PR limit. `release.yml` pins rust-toolchain and crates-io-auth to the glypher SHAs. The crates-io-auth SHA was different from the other repos for the same `v1.0.5` tag.
- `chore:` add `.mise.toml` (rust, prek, tombi, zizmor, cargo-binstall, cargo-audit, cargo-nextest; build, test, lint, lint:fix, format, format:check, audit, check, check:actions, hooks), the generated `mise.lock`, `.editorconfig`, and the canonical `.yamlfmt.yaml` and `tombi.toml`. The yamllint line-length setting in `.yamllint.yaml` is kept.

## Validation

- `prek run --all-files` passes. actionlint needs `shellcheck` on PATH, so it was run with `mise x shellcheck@0.11.0`.
- `cargo test --all-features` passes (22 + 12 + 5 tests).
- `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` passes with the new lint.

## Manual steps

- Confirm the crates.io trusted publisher for `metrics_ipc_collector` still points at this repo and `release.yml`.
- Confirm "Allow GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests" is enabled, since release-please needs it.
- Confirm the pre-commit.ci app is not still enabled on the repo, since `.pre-commit-config.yaml` is gone.

## Pre-existing failures

None.

contributions.title: ci: standardise tooling configs
contributions.bodyHTML:
Standardises tooling with the glypher reference setup. This is a crates.io binary crate, so the publish flow is unchanged.

Note: the local `main` checkout has an uncommitted `[lints.clippy]` block in `Cargo.toml`. This PR is based on the committed `main`, and it adds the same lint block, so that local edit will conflict on the next pull. Drop the local edit before pulling.

## Changes

- `build:` add `[lints.clippy]` (all and pedantic, warn) and `[lints.rust] unsafe_code = "deny"`.
- `style:` rewrite 8 test assertions from `assert!(x.is_empty())` to `assert_eq!(x.len(), 0)` (or `assert_ne!`). The new `assert_is_empty` lint fires on them and would fail `-D warnings`. This commit is test code only.
- `ci:` `prek.toml` gets the conventional-commit commit-msg hook, which was missing. `ci.yml` and `release.yml` pin `Swatinem/rust-cache` and `rust-lang/crates-io-auth-action` to the glypher SHAs. `dependabot.yml` gets `open-pull-requests-limit`.
- `chore:` add `.mise.toml` (rust, prek, tombi, zizmor, cargo-binstall, cargo-audit, cargo-nextest; build, build:release, test, lint, lint:fix, format, format:check, audit, check, check:actions, hooks), the generated `mise.lock`, `.editorconfig`, and the canonical `tombi.toml`, which drops the `**/uv.lock` exclude because there is no Python here.

The existing `prek.toml` hooks, the `.yamlfmt.yaml`, the CI pre-commit and build jobs, and the release-please and publish flow already matched and are unchanged.

## Validation

- `prek run --all-files` passes. actionlint needs `shellcheck` on PATH, so it was run with `mise x shellcheck@0.11.0`.
- `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` passes.
- `cargo test --all-features` passes (145 tests).

## Manual steps

- Confirm the crates.io trusted publisher for `pets-configurator` still points at this repo and `release.yml`.
- Confirm "Allow GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests" is enabled, since release-please needs it.

## Pre-existing failures

None.

contributions.title: ci: standardise tooling with prek, tombi, zizmor and shared lint configs
contributions.bodyHTML:
## What changed

- `.mise.toml`: added `hugo`, `prek`, `shellcheck`, `tombi` (pinned `1.2.4` to match the tombi-pre-commit rev in `prek.toml`), `zizmor`. Replaced `taplo` with `tombi`. Added `hooks`, `check:actions`. `check` now runs `check:actions`. Existing tasks kept.
- `prek.toml` (new): base hooks at glypher SHAs plus local `prettier --check`.
- `.editorconfig`, `.yamlfmt.yaml`, `tombi.toml`: canonical. `taplo.toml` removed.
- `.prettierrc.toml`: canonical plus the existing go-template plugin and `layouts/**/*.html` override. `printWidth` kept at 120 (see below).
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: `pre-commit` (prek-action) and `check` (`mise run check`) jobs, SHA-pinned, `persist-credentials: false`.
- `.github/dependabot.yml`: github-actions, gomod, npm; weekly, 7-day cooldown.
- `mise.lock` added (tracked, as in the other repos).
- Separate `style:` commit: tombi formatting of `exampleSite/hugo.toml`.

## Decisions

- **printWidth 120, not canonical 100.** At 100, prettier would reflow existing content and templates. 120 also matches the repo's content width.
- **No release-please, no publish job.** This is a Hugo theme, not a published package or a site.
- **No GitHub Pages workflow.** The repo is a theme with no deploy target.
- **No `build` or `test` task.** The `exampleSite` build needs a Hugo module setup (`exampleSite` has no `go.mod`, and `HUGO_MODULE_REPLACEMENTS` does not resolve from that directory). Rather than ship a failing task, `check` covers format, lint and workflow linting only. Worth adding a proper smoke build later.

## Manual steps

- None.

## Pre-existing failures

- None found by `prek run --all-files` or `mise run check` after the `style:` commit.

contributions.title: ci: standardise tooling configs
contributions.bodyHTML:
Brings glypher in line with the canonical shared configs. glypher is the reference repo, so the change is small.

## Changes

- `build:` inherit workspace lints. `[workspace.lints]` now sets `clippy::all` and `clippy::pedantic` to warn and `unsafe_code` to deny. Every member crate (`glypher`, `glypher-cli`, `web`) opts in with `[lints] workspace = true`. The per-crate `#![warn(clippy::pedantic)]` attributes are removed because the workspace lint replaces them. No code changes were needed, and clippy passes with `-D warnings`.
- `chore:` add `.editorconfig`, and replace `tombi.toml` with the canonical version (adds the TOML 1.0 pin comment).

Unchanged, because they already match: `.mise.toml`, `prek.toml`, `.yamlfmt.yaml`, `.github/dependabot.yml`, the CI, pages and release workflows, and `release-please-config.json`.

## Validation

- `prek run --all-files` passes (tombi, yamlfmt, zizmor, actionlint, fmt, clippy).
- `cargo test --workspace --all-features` passes.
- `cargo check -p web --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --all-features` passes.

## Manual steps

None.

## Pre-existing failures

None. Cargo prints existing `unused field in workspace.package` and `homepage is redundant` manifest warnings. They predate this PR and are not errors.
